INSERT INTO hot_search_event (event_id, stat_date, happened_at, event_hour, user_id, raw_keyword, grouping_keyword, group_id, group_name, vector_version) VALUES
(#{event.eventId}, #{event.statDate}, #{event.happenedAt}, #{event.eventHour}, #{event.userId}, #{event.rawKeyword}, #{event.groupingKeyword}, #{event.groupId}, #{event.groupName}, #{event.vectorVersion})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_id = hot_search_event.event_id

INSERT INTO hot_search_daily_group (stat_date, group_id, group_name, vector_version, search_count, user_count, score, rank_no) SELECT #{date}, ranked.group_id, ranked.group_name, ranked.vector_version, ranked.search_count, ranked.user_count, ranked.score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ranked.score DESC, ranked.group_id) FROM ( SELECT group_id, MAX(group_name) AS group_name, MAX(vector_version) AS vector_version, COUNT(*) AS search_count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id, event_hour) AS score FROM hot_search_event WHERE stat_date = #{date} GROUP BY group_id ) ranked
